content.title: About
content.content: The pomegranate beverage contains 40‑50 % pomegranate juice and belongs to the light non‑alcoholic drink category. It offers a bright fruity flavor with a mildly sweet‑tart aftertaste and lower calories compared to pure juice.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Pomegranate juice is rich in polyphenols, especially anthocyanins, which give the drink its deep red color.
The sugar content is lower than in 100 % juice because the juice is diluted with water.
Pomegranate has been used traditionally in Mediterranean cuisine and is a symbol of abundance and health.
In many markets, drinks with 40‑50 % juice are labeled “light,” indicating reduced calories and sugar.
Pomegranate trees can live over 200 years, with harvests typically from September to November.

items.title: Rich in antioxidants
items.content: Polyphenols in pomegranate juice help neutralize free radicals and support cellular health.

items.title: Cardiovascular support
items.content: Studies suggest regular consumption may help lower blood pressure and improve lipid profiles.

items.title: Aids digestion
items.content: Acids and dietary fiber in the juice stimulate gastrointestinal function.

items.title: Immune system boost
items.content: Vitamin C and other phytochemicals contribute to stronger immune defenses.

items.title: Low calorie
items.content: Dilution with water makes the beverage less calorie‑dense, suitable for weight management.

items.title: Pomegranate allergy
items.content: A small number of individuals may experience allergic reactions to pomegranate.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Although labeled “light,” people with diabetes should still monitor overall glycemic impact.

items.title: Medication interactions
items.content: Pomegranate can affect the metabolism of certain drugs, such as statins; consult a physician if you take medication.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Serve chilled as a refreshing snack, use in cocktails, smoothies, or as a base for fruit punches. It pairs well with mint, lime, and berries.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep refrigerated and consume within 5‑7 days.
